cards.example_en: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐教会了我骑自行车。
cards.explain_zh: elder 多放在亲属名词前；比较年龄用 older than。

cards.example_en: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐教会了我骑自行车。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A small glass ornament sparkled on the wooden shelf.
cards.example_zh: 木架上的一件小玻璃饰品闪闪发亮。
cards.explain_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词末音节读/ment/。

cards.example_en: A small glass ornament sparkled on the wooden shelf.
cards.example_zh: 木架上的一件小玻璃饰品闪闪发亮。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We had a fabulous picnic beside the lake yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我们在湖边度过了一段美妙的野餐时光。
cards.explain_zh: 表“极好的”多用于非正式语境，语气较强。

cards.example_en: Although tourism can generate fabulous wealth, its economic benefits are not always shared fairly among local residents.
cards.example_zh: 尽管旅游业能创造巨额财富，其经济收益却并非总能在当地居民之间公平分配。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The museum displayed armour worn by an ancient warrior.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出了古代战士穿过的盔甲。
cards.explain_zh: 常用于古代战士；现代军人通常用soldier。

cards.example_en: The museum displayed armour worn by an ancient warrior.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出了古代战士穿过的盔甲。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The shop received a fresh shipment of apples today.
cards.example_zh: 这家店今天收到了一批新运来的苹果。
cards.explain_zh: 指一批货物时可数；指装运过程时不可数。

cards.example_en: Rescuers pulled a survivor from the flooded house.
cards.example_zh: 救援人员从被淹的房屋中救出了一名幸存者。
cards.explain_zh: survivor指人；survival指幸存或生存。

cards.example_en: White foam covered my hands as I washed the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 洗碗时，白色泡沫盖满了我的双手。
cards.explain_zh: foam作泡沫或泡沫材料时通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Manufacturers often use foam packaging to protect fragile goods, although some types are difficult to recycle.
cards.example_zh: 制造商常用泡沫包装保护易碎商品，但某些泡沫材料难以回收。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Hearing your story helped me understand your viewpoint.
cards.example_zh: 听了你的经历，我更能理解你的看法了。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“从某人的角度看”时，搭配 from。

cards.example_en: Her concise directions helped us find the station easily.
cards.example_zh: 她简明的指路说明让我们轻松找到了车站。
cards.explain_zh: 不仅指短，还强调信息清楚且无赘述。

cards.example_en: Clear and concise public health advice enables people to understand risks and make informed decisions quickly.
cards.example_zh: 清晰简明的公共卫生建议使人们能够了解风险，并迅速作出明智决定。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Through daily repetition, I finally remembered the whole song.
cards.example_zh: 通过每天反复练习，我终于记住了整首歌。
cards.explain_zh: repetition强调重复；rehearsal指演出前的排练。

cards.example_en: The importer showed us coffee beans from several countries.
cards.example_zh: 那位进口商向我们展示了来自多个国家的咖啡豆。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指进口商，也可指进口商品的国家。

cards.example_en: A country that becomes a major food importer may face greater exposure to international price fluctuations.
cards.example_zh: 一个成为主要粮食进口国的国家可能更容易受到国际价格波动的影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I swim for recreation at the local leisure centre.
cards.example_zh: 我在当地休闲中心游泳消遣。
cards.explain_zh: 表示休闲娱乐通常不可数；别与re-creation重新创造混淆。

cards.example_en: Access to green spaces encourages outdoor recreation and can improve both physical health and mental wellbeing.
cards.example_zh: 能够方便地使用绿地有助于鼓励户外休闲活动，并可改善身心健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We walked along the riverside after a late lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们吃过午饭后，沿着河边散步。
cards.explain_zh: 常作名词定语，如 a riverside park（河滨公园）。

cards.example_en: We walked along the riverside after a late lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们吃过午饭后，沿着河边散步。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A crumb fell from my toast onto the table.
cards.example_zh: 一粒面包屑从我的吐司上掉到了桌上。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词；表示面包屑时常用复数crumbs。

cards.example_en: Even small food scraps, such as bread crumbs, can attract pests when waste is poorly managed.
cards.example_zh: 如果垃圾处理不当，即使是面包屑这样的小块食物残渣，也会招来害虫。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill.
cards.example_zh: 我们推着自行车爬上了陡坡。
cards.explain_zh: steep既形容坡陡，也形容价格高或变化剧烈。

cards.example_en: A steep rise in housing costs can force young workers to move away from major cities.
cards.example_zh: 住房成本急剧上涨可能迫使年轻劳动者离开大城市。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Unequal access to technology can deprive disadvantaged students of valuable opportunities to develop essential digital skills.
cards.example_zh: 获取技术资源的机会不平等，可能使弱势学生失去培养必要数字技能的宝贵机会。
cards.explain_zh: 固定结构deprive sb of sth，介词用of。

cards.example_en: Helping our neighbour carry groceries was a kind deed.
cards.example_zh: 帮邻居提食品杂货是一桩善举。
cards.explain_zh: 表示行为时较正式；房产契据常用复数deeds。

cards.example_en: There was an awkward silence after I forgot her name.
cards.example_zh: 我忘了她的名字，随后出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。
cards.explain_zh: awkward可指社交尴尬，也可指动作笨拙。

cards.example_en: There was an awkward silence after I forgot her name.
cards.example_zh: 我忘了她的名字，随后出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A nurse brought fresh blankets into the children's ward.
cards.example_zh: 一名护士把干净的毯子送进了儿科病房。
cards.explain_zh: 作动词通常用ward off，表示抵挡、避开。

cards.example_en: The young violinist gave an exceptional performance last night.
cards.example_zh: 那位年轻的小提琴手昨晚的演奏十分出色。
cards.explain_zh: 常指特别优秀；exceptional circumstances指特殊情况。

cards.example_en: Students with exceptional ability may require additional challenges to remain engaged in classroom learning.
cards.example_zh: 能力出众的学生可能需要更有挑战性的任务，才能持续投入课堂学习。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Tap the camera icon to take a quick photo.
cards.example_zh: 点一下相机图标，快速拍张照片。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指屏幕图标，也可指有代表性的偶像或文化象征。

cards.example_en: A familiar cultural icon can attract international visitors and strengthen a city's identity in tourism campaigns.
cards.example_zh: 一个广为人知的文化象征可以吸引国际游客，并在旅游宣传中强化城市特色。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: It is risky to cycle home without lights.
cards.example_zh: 骑车回家时不开车灯很危险。
cards.explain_zh: 常用It is risky to do sth表示做某事有风险。

cards.example_en: These old photographs need careful preservation to prevent further damage.
cards.example_zh: 这些老照片需要妥善保存，以免进一步受损。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；the preservation of后接保护对象。

cards.example_en: Governments can steer investment towards renewable energy by offering financial incentives and establishing clear environmental standards.
cards.example_zh: 政府可以通过提供经济激励和制定明确的环境标准，引导资金投向可再生能源。
cards.explain_zh: steer clear of表示避开某人或某事。

cards.example_en: The ambulance took the casualty to a nearby hospital.
cards.example_zh: 救护车把伤者送往附近的医院。
cards.explain_zh: 包括受伤者和死者，不等于仅指死亡的fatality。

cards.example_en: Curiosity led me to open the dusty wooden box.
cards.example_zh: 好奇心驱使我打开了那个积满灰尘的木盒。
cards.explain_zh: 表示好奇心时不可数；表示稀奇物品时可数。

cards.example_en: My younger sibling always borrows my favourite blue jacket.
cards.example_zh: 我家那个小的总爱借我最喜欢的蓝色夹克。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词，单数指一个兄弟或姐妹，不区分性别。

cards.example_en: My younger sibling always borrows my favourite blue jacket.
cards.example_zh: 我家那个小的总爱借我最喜欢的蓝色夹克。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Blend the bananas and milk until the mixture is smooth.
cards.example_zh: 把香蕉和牛奶搅打至顺滑。
cards.explain_zh: blend A with B表示将两者融合；blend in指融入。

cards.example_en: A water shortage forced us to take shorter showers.
cards.example_zh: 缺水迫使我们缩短淋浴时间。
cards.explain_zh: 常用a shortage of；“缺少”也可说be short of。

cards.example_en: A shortage of affordable housing can force essential workers to live far from their workplaces.
cards.example_zh: 可负担住房短缺可能迫使关键岗位的工作人员住在远离工作地点的地方。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A wasp landed on the edge of my glass.
cards.example_zh: 一只黄蜂落在了我的杯口上。
cards.explain_zh: wasp是黄蜂，bee是蜜蜂；两者不是同一种昆虫。

cards.example_en: She tied a neat bow around the gift box.
cards.example_zh: 她在礼盒上系了一个整齐的蝴蝶结。
cards.explain_zh: 弓、蝴蝶结读/bəʊ/；鞠躬、船头读/baʊ/。

cards.example_en: The loud music was an unwelcome interruption during dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚餐时响起的吵闹音乐令人扫兴。
cards.explain_zh: 可形容人、消息或变化；feel unwelcome指感到不受欢迎。

cards.example_en: The oyster shell felt rough against my fingers.
cards.example_zh: 牡蛎壳摸起来很粗糙。
cards.explain_zh: the world is your oyster指你有无限机会。

cards.example_en: The oyster shell felt rough against my fingers.
cards.example_zh: 牡蛎壳摸起来很粗糙。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Community elders can help preserve local traditions by sharing their knowledge and experiences with younger generations.
word.example_zh: 社区长者可以通过向年轻一代分享知识和经历，帮助传承当地传统。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: I swim for recreation at the local leisure centre.
word.example_zh: 我在当地休闲中心游泳消遣。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: The young violinist gave an exceptional performance last night.
word.example_zh: 那位年轻的小提琴手昨晚的演奏十分出色。
